不裁切、不贴回：只用重绘 prompt 的「编辑范围」控制覆盖面

基底 = 各画风的**首图**（没有重跑首图）；每格都是**一整张新图**（无裁切、无贴回、不可能拼错边界）。 每次调用都带 画风参考图 + STYLE LANGUAGE 条款（tinkle 手写 19 条，tid/fuzichoco 派生 10 条）， 再接一段「编辑范围」要求（见下）。分辨率 2K，固件 v5，无 detail suffix。
怎么读表：「与首图差异」是重绘结果缩放到首图尺寸后的逐像素最大通道差 —— 背景= 主体框以外的平均差（越小说明背景越没被动）、脸= 脸部框内平均差（`noface` 那格应该很小）、 大改= 差异 >24 的像素占比。这些都只是「动了多少」的量，画得好不好还要看图。
⚠️ 补记（2026-09-24）：本页是「加身份锁之前」的实验记录。
其中 person_noface 那档把 tid 参考图的角色（粉发 + 水手服 + 金鱼/水波）整套搬了进来 —— 因为范围句允许改"身体/衣服/头发"，模型就换了整套设计。
现已加入 IDENTITY AND CONTENT LOCK（930 字符，追加在提示词最后）：源图是身份/设计/内容的唯一真值，不许从画风参考图搬任何东西；复测后该格已回到源图角色（192.5 / 24.6 / 96.0，见 data/20260924/repaint-scope2/ 与 BEST-PIPELINE §三十一 补记）。

3. 每格用的「编辑范围」原文

full:          （不加，= 现在的整图重绘）

person_only:   EDIT SCOPE (this pass): repaint ONLY the character. Keep the background, furniture, props,
               floor, walls, curtains and the lighting pattern exactly as they are in the source: same
               shapes, same colours, same values, same placement. Do not repaint, restyle, move, add or
               remove any background element.

person_noface: EDIT SCOPE (this pass): you may refine the character's body, clothing, hair mass, hands,
               legwear and footwear, but preserve the FACE exactly as drawn in the source - same eye shape
               and size, same lash pattern, same iris colour and internal detail, same brows, nose, mouth,
               blush and face shading, same position. Do not redraw, sharpen, enlarge, beautify or restyle
               the face.

details:       EDIT SCOPE (this pass): concentrate on the small worn details - gloved hands and fingers,
               ribbons and bows, corset lacing and buckle hardware, garter straps and stocking lace, shoe
               straps, laces and charms, necklace and other jewellery. Make each of them read as a
               continuous, countable, physically anchored structure. Leave the face, the hair mass, the
               dress silhouette, the pose and the background otherwise untouched.

lines_only:    EDIT SCOPE (this pass): repair line structure only. Connect contours that are clearly broken
               and merge stray fragments so the main curves read as continuous strokes. Do not change
               colours, shading, materials, shapes, positions, framing or the amount of detail anywhere.
